# Setup {#sec-setup}

```{python}
#| label: setup
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from rdrobust import rdrobust

from write_helpers import write_macro, write_tabular, save_figure, OUT

# --- Config ---------------------------------------------------------------
DATA_PATH = Path("scored_notes.parquet")   # HPC output
CUTOFF    = 0.4
POLY      = 1                              # matches rdrobust local-linear
#KERNEL    = "triangular"
#SEED      = 20260824
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

write_macro("cutoff", CUTOFF, digits=2)
write_macro("polyOrder", POLY)
```

```{python}
#| label: load-data
if DATA_PATH.exists():
    df = pd.read_parquet(DATA_PATH)
    

write_macro("nNotes", len(df))

print(f"N = {len(df):,}")
```
